chunks: Many a prophet had We sent to the earlier communities,
ai.seo_question: How many prophets did God send to earlier communities?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the universality of divine guidance, affirming that no nation was left without a warner, which validates the legitimacy of the Prophet Muhammad as the final link in this unbroken chain. It highlights the theological principle of 'Tawatur' (mass transmission) of prophethood, reinforcing the continuity of revelation from Adam to the Seal of the Prophets.
